title: Ray Tracer Scene
description: TOML scene or object library consumed by internal/sceneio. Primitives are array-of-tables (e.g. [[box]]); config blocks are single tables (e.g. [camera]).
$comment: Source of truth for the loader: internal/sceneio/toml.go. Update this file whenever the TOML format changes.

extends.description: Path to a base scene file (relative to this file or absolute). The base is loaded first; this file overrides [camera], [environment], [[light]], [[campfire]], and may add [[include]] entries or [[terrain.pad]] stubs. Used for scene variants that share most content.

camera.description: TOML table [camera]. Optional starting viewpoint when the scene loads.

environment.description: TOML table [environment]. Sky gradient, ambient light, and directional sun.

interact.description: TOML table [interact]. One use-target for the player (E key). Typically on small object files, not full scenes.

include.description: TOML array-of-tables [[include]]. Instantiates another TOML file with a placement transform.

box.description: TOML [[box]]. Axis-aligned boxes; optional [[box.hole]] sub-tables cut rectangular openings.

cylinder.description: TOML [[cylinder]]. Vertical cylinders (optionally tapered with radius_top).

torus.description: TOML [[torus]]. Ring torus in the XZ plane (major/minor radii).

ring.description: TOML [[ring]]. Vertical annulus (washer) in the XZ plane.

lens.description: TOML [[lens]]. Biconvex optical lens along +Y (spyglass, optics).

terrain.description: TOML [[terrain]]. Procedural height field with optional [[terrain.feature]] hills/valleys and [[terrain.pad]] building pads.

water.description: TOML [[water]]. Circular water surface with ripples.

light.description: TOML [[light]]. Soft area lights (spherical emissive sources).

campfire.description: TOML [[campfire]]. Flickering warm light source (no visible geometry).

point.description: TOML [[point]]. Named locations in scene space (player spawn, future NPC targets, etc.).

npc.description: TOML array-of-tables [[npc]]. Procedural humanoid (or other YAML rig) spawns. The runtime NPC manager loads the rig, appends limb primitives to the scene, and animates locomotion when speed > 0.

door.description: TOML [[door]]. Swinging door panels with hinge animation and E-key interaction.

document.description: TOML [[document]]. Readable paper with rasterized text on the +Z face. The runtime spawns a thin box, registers an E-key interact target, and animates pick-up/read/put-away.

vec3.description: Three-component vector [x, y, z] in world units. Write components as floats (e.g. 0.0, not 0).

vec2.description: Two-component vector [a, b], typically X/Z or U/V.

rgb.description: Linear RGB color [r, g, b]. Components are often in 0..1 but HDR emit colors may exceed 1.

material.description: Shading model. diffuse: Lambertian; mirror: perfect reflector; metal: glossy metal (use rough); glass: refractive (use ior, transmit); emit: emissive; checker: two-color pattern (planes use albedo2).

texture.description: Procedural world-space texture id. Omitted or "none" leaves the surface untextured (albedo only). Capture_* slots are filled at runtime by the portal system.

sky.description: Preset sky dome and sun/moon appearance.

on_use.description: Handler invoked when the player uses (E) this interactable within use_range.

sound_id.description: Named ambient sound loop synthesized at load time.

rotate_x.description: Rotation about +X in degrees about the primitive's geometric center. Defaults to 0.

rotate_y.description: Rotation about +Y in degrees about the primitive's geometric center. Defaults to 0.

rotate_z.description: Rotation about +Z in degrees about the primitive's geometric center. Defaults to 0.

surface_albedo.description: Base color or tint multiplied by procedural texture.

surface_rough.description: Surface roughness for glossy materials (metal, diffuse with soft highlights). 0 = mirror-smooth.

surface_ior.description: Index of refraction for glass. Defaults to 1.5 when omitted.

surface_reflect.description: Extra reflection weight blended on top of the material model (0..1 typical).

surface_transmit.description: Transmission weight for glass-like surfaces (0 = opaque, 1 = fully transmissive).

primitive_surface.description: Material and shading fields merged into every shaded primitive table.

transform_origin.description: Rotation anchor in local space. Default "center" (geometric center or sub-scene bounds center for includes). Use [x,y,z] for a corner, hinge, or file origin.

box_extent_pos_size.description: Box defined by one corner (pos_*) and positive extents along +X, +Y, +Z.

box_extent_min_max.description: Legacy box definition by opposite corners (min strictly less than max on each axis).

box_hole.description: TOML [[box.hole]] nested under a [[box]]. Rectangular void subtracted from the parent box; should pierce fully through the faces it cuts.

normal.description: Plane normal (need not be unit length; normalized at load).

d.description: Plane equation n·p = d (signed distance along normal).

albedo2.description: Second color for checker material; ignored for other materials.

hole.description: Nested [[box.hole]] tables belonging to this box.

pos_x.description: Minimum X corner of the footprint square (like [[box]] pos_x).

pos_z.description: Minimum Z corner of the footprint square.

width.description: Diameter when uniform (also used as bottom diameter when width_bottom is omitted).

width_bottom.description: Bottom diameter for a tapered cylinder. Defaults to width.

width_top.description: Top diameter for a tapered cylinder. Defaults to width_bottom.

open_min.description: Omit the bottom end cap (hollow tube).

open_max.description: Omit the top end cap (hollow tube).

center.description: Torus center (ring lies in XZ plane).

major.description: Major radius (ring centerline to tube center).

aperture.description: Clear aperture radius in the XZ plane.

r_front.description: Front (+Y) spherical cap radius of curvature.

r_back.description: Back (−Y) spherical cap radius of curvature.

thickness.description: Center thickness along the optical axis.

terrain_feature.description: TOML [[terrain.feature]] nested under [[terrain]]. Adds a smooth hill or valley bump to the height field.

kind.description: peak (default): positive height raises terrain. valley: positive height is negated to carve downward.

pos.description: Feature center [x, z] in terrain-local coordinates.

height.description: Bump amplitude in world units. For valleys, a positive value is treated as negative depth.

width.description: Characteristic width of the bump. Defaults to 1 when omitted or 0.

steepness.description: Profile sharpness (higher = steeper sides). Defaults to 2 when omitted or 0.

extend.description: Anisotropic stretch [x, z] of the bump footprint. Defaults to [1, 1].

angle.description: Rotation of the bump in degrees about Y.

terrain_pad.description: TOML [[terrain.pad]] nested under [[terrain]], or stub pads in extend files. Flattens a rectangular site to a target level with a smooth margin.

center.description: Pad center [x, z] in terrain-local coordinates.

half.description: Half-extents [half_x, half_z] of the inner flat rectangle.

level.description: Target ground height inside the pad.

margin.description: Blend width around the pad edge where height eases to natural terrain.

origin.description: World position of the terrain corner. Only origin[0] (X) and origin[2] (Z) are used.

base.description: Base elevation before detail noise and features.

detail_scale.description: Spatial frequency of detail noise. Defaults to 0.1 when omitted or 0.

step.description: Height quantization step for a terraced look (0 = smooth).

grid_cell.description: Internal sampling grid cell size for the height field mesh.

grass.description: Texture on gentle slopes. Defaults to grass.

rock.description: Texture on steep slopes. Defaults to stone.

snow.description: Texture at high elevation/slope. Defaults to snow.

grass_col.description: Tint for grass layer. All zeros default to white (show texture as authored).

slope_lo.description: Slope angle (degrees) where grass→rock blend begins.

slope_hi.description: Slope angle where grass→rock blend completes.

snow_lo.description: Height or blend threshold where snow begins.

snow_hi.description: Height or blend threshold where snow is fully white.

pos.description: Disk center [x, z] in world space.

radius.description: Horizontal radius of the water surface.

ripple_direction.description: Direction [x, z] the ripples travel along.

radius.description: Physical radius of the emissive sphere (soft shadow penumbra).

brightness.description: Intensity multiplier applied to color at load time. Defaults to 1.

campfire.description: Animated flickering point light without geometry.

color.description: Emissive tint. Defaults to warm orange if omitted.

yaw.description: Horizontal look angle in degrees. Forward at yaw 0 is −Z (same convention as NPC heading and player movement).

pitch.description: Vertical look angle in degrees (negative = look down).

sun.description: Visible sun/moon disc appearance. Position comes from environment.sun_dir.

glow.description: Halo strength around the disc. Omitted or 0 defaults to 1 when sun is configured.

sun_dir.description: Direction toward the sun (normalized at load). Zero vector disables directional sun.

hint.description: HUD prompt shown when the player is in range (e.g. "Exit").

use_range.description: Maximum distance from the player to the interact center.

center.description: World-space point for range tests (often the object origin).

id.description: Unique name referenced by game code (portals, NPC goals, etc.).

pos.description: Anchor position. For player spawn with floor_y, X/Z are horizontal and Y is ignored.

floor_y.description: Optional walkable surface height for player spawn (adds eye height above this Y).

yaw.description: Optional initial look yaw for player spawn.

pitch.description: Optional initial look pitch for player spawn.

npc.description: TOML [[npc]]. Procedural character spawn (YAML rig + runtime pose/locomotion).

rig.description: Path to a YAML rig file (relative to repo root or absolute), e.g. data/rigs/humanoid.yaml.

pose.description: Named pose from the rig YAML (e.g. idle). Default: idle. Upper body switches to walk when speed > 0.

at.description: Spawn anchor [x, y, z]. Y is feet height; 0 uses ground height at x,z.

yaw.description: Root facing yaw in degrees (same convention as [camera].yaw: 0 = −Z, 90 = −X, 270 = +X).

speed.description: Locomotion speed in m/s. 0 = idle (planted feet, no hip advance).

heading.description: Walk direction in degrees (same as yaw convention). When omitted, defaults to yaw. Ignored when patrol or goal is set.

patrol.description: Closed-loop patrol waypoints as [x, y, z] arrays. Y is an optional feet-height hint (0 = sample ground at runtime). Mutually exclusive with goal.

goal.description: Single navigation target [x, y, z]. Y is an optional feet-height hint (0 = sample ground at runtime). Agent stops within ~0.2 m horizontally. Mutually exclusive with patrol.

door.description: TOML [[door]]. Swinging door with dynamic panel box(es) and optional nested [door.interact].

id.description: Unique door name for interaction and debugging.

kind.description: Single panel or paired double doors. Default: single.

hinge.description: Hinge edge position for single doors (or left panel on double doors).

hinge_left.description: Left panel hinge for double doors.

hinge_right.description: Right panel hinge for double doors.

axis.description: Rotation axis through the hinge. Default: y.

swing.description: one_way always opens the same direction; both picks from the player side when closed.

panel_file.description: Path to a TOML file with the moving panel geometry (boxes, cylinders, spheres). For single doors.

panel_left_file.description: Left leaf panel geometry file for double doors.

panel_right_file.description: Right leaf panel geometry file for double doors.

panel_closed_angle.description: Optional per-panel closed-pose rotation in degrees about each hinge.

document.description: TOML [[document]]. A4-style paper with dynamic text rasterized at load time. pos_x/y/z is the anchor corner; after rotation the lowest point rests at pos_y. Text appears on the +Z face (use rotate_x = -90 for a flat desk memo). The runtime document manager spawns a centered thin box and handles read/put-away animation.

id.description: Unique document name for interaction and debugging. Default: document_N.

pos_x.description: Anchor corner X in the parent/include frame.

pos_y.description: Surface Y the paper rests on after rotation (lowest rotated point).

pos_z.description: Anchor corner Z in the parent/include frame.

width.description: Paper width in meters. Default: 0.21 (A4 width).

height.description: Paper height in meters. Default: 0.297 (A4 height).

headline.description: Optional headline rendered larger at the top of the page.

paragraphs.description: Body text blocks. Each entry is one paragraph; long strings may be split on blank lines.

font.description: Path to a TTF/OTF file (relative to this TOML file). Default: assets/PixelOperator.ttf.

font_size_px.description: Body font size in pixels for the 512×512 raster. Default: 18.

albedo.description: Tint multiplied with the rasterized ink and paper grain.

on_use.description: Optional handler id invoked when the player opens the document (after the read animation starts). Overrides top-level on_use when [document.interact] is present.

interact.description: Optional overrides for the auto-registered read interactable.

hint.description: HUD prompt when in range. Default: press {{use_button}} to read.

use_range.description: Maximum distance from the player to the document center. Default: 1.2.

on_use.description: Handler id invoked when the document is opened.

file.description: Path to the included TOML (relative to the parent file or absolute).

at.description: Where transform_origin lands in the parent scene. When the parent has terrain, at.y is an offset above ground at (at.x, at.z); 0 snaps the anchor to ground (or a terrain pad at the anchor).

follow_terrain.description: When true, Y is resolved in a post-pass after all terrain is merged: the include is shifted vertically so its anchor sits on the baked height field. Only this [[include]] line is snapped; nested includes without the flag move rigidly with the parent. For scattered props, set on each child include, not on layout files.

instance.description: When true, identical geometry from the included file is merged into a GPU instancing batch (TLAS/BLAS). The included file may be a layout of multiple [[include]] children; each unique mesh is instanced separately. Imposes an instance count limit.

params.description: Template parameters passed to the included file (Go text/template data). Use {{.name}} in the child file; helpers: add, sub, mul, div, neg, seq, vec3, orVec3.
